name: ceo-inbox-shadow-draft
description: Store a non-surfaced, non-sent shadow draft for a punted inbox message (Seen / Urgent / Stuck). Never creates approvals, notifications, or Nylas drafts. Skips high-sensitivity threads (board, investors, legal, spouse). Used during triage so later sent-observe can score decision equivalence into autonomy_action_log.

inputs.source_message_id: string (Nylas message id that was punted)
inputs.subject: string
inputs.body: string (the shadow draft Curia would have sent — never shown to the CEO)
